name: Archie research scout (daily X + web scan into the Ideas ledger, weekly digest beat)

knobs.note: BH-4065: 0 stops scan and digest before any request. Read by bin/archie-research.sh as ${ARCHIE_RESEARCH_ENABLED:-1}; any value other than 0 or 1 is one warn line in logs/archie-research.log and the default.

BH-4065: dollars the lane may spend per UTC day across the xAI X searches and the web scan and scoring agent-calls, summed from its own archie_research ledger (GET /api/archie-research/spend, every unpriced attempt at ARCHIE_RESEARCH_RESERVE_USD). Checked before EVERY billable call; reached = no further call that day and ONE ALERTS line. An unreadable ledger makes no call (fail closed). 0 makes no billable call at all. Each agent-call's own bound is min(ARCHIE_RESEARCH_LLM_MAX_USD, cap minus today's spend). Seeded as settings row lane.archie-research.archie_research_usd_cap_day = 3.00 (BH-4762, was 1.00). Read as ${ARCHIE_RESEARCH_USD_CAP_DAY:-3.00}.

BH-4065: paid tries per research key (one topic's X search, the day's web scan, a find, a scoring batch, a week's digest) before the key is left failed. Read as ${ARCHIE_RESEARCH_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-3}; outside 1..10 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4065: the dollars counted toward the daily cap for a billable call before it is priced, and for any attempt that never got a price (in flight, crashed, or no usage in the answer). Never $0 (D11). Read as ${ARCHIE_RESEARCH_RESERVE_USD:-0.25}.

BH-4065: USD cap on each web-scan and scoring agent-call (AGENT_CALL_BUDGET_USD_ARCHIE_RESEARCH). BH-4762: each call gets the min of this and what is left of ARCHIE_RESEARCH_USD_CAP_DAY today, floored to the cent, and does not run below ARCHIE_RESEARCH_RESERVE_USD. The vendor checks it between turns only, so one turn can overshoot it. Read as ${ARCHIE_RESEARCH_LLM_MAX_USD:-0.50}.

knobs.default: AI software factories|autonomous SDLC|agent harnesses|improving AI dev loops|Anthropic and AI vendor releases|new AI model releases (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, open-weight) and what they change for coding agents|automated SDLC and software factory talks on YouTube
knobs.note: BH-4065: pipe-separated topics, one X search each per day (at most 10), also listed in the web scan's prompt. BH-4762 added new model releases and YouTube talks, and seeds settings row lane.archie-research.archie_research_topics with this default. Read as ${ARCHIE_RESEARCH_TOPICS:-<this default>}.

BH-4065: finds (failed ones re-offered first, then new ones) claimed and scored per scan, in chunks of ARCHIE_RESEARCH_SCORE_BATCH. The rest are logged deferred: a failed one is offered again next scan, a new one only if a later search returns it. Read as ${ARCHIE_RESEARCH_MAX_ITEMS:-20}; outside 1..100 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4762: finds per scoring agent-call; smaller chunks bound one turn's size because the vendor's --max-budget-usd only stops between turns. Read as ${ARCHIE_RESEARCH_SCORE_BATCH:-6}; outside 1..25 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4065: a find that applies to us with at least this score (0-10) becomes a gate_pending proposal on the Ideas screen. Read as ${ARCHIE_RESEARCH_MIN_SCORE:-7}; outside 0..10 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4065: the project whose Ideas ledger (product_proposals) receives Archie's proposals. Read as ${ARCHIE_RESEARCH_PROJECT:-cromford}; a value that is not a project name is one warn line and the default.

BH-4065: dollars per xAI server-side tool call (x_search), added to the token price of each X search's cost row (bin/lib/archie-research.sh ar_price). Kept here rather than in catalog/model-prices.json so that shared table is untouched. A non-number leaves the row unpriced, never $0. Read by bin/lib/archie-research.sh ar_price as ${ARCHIE_XAI_TOOL_CALL_USD:-0.005}.

Not a knob: Archie's OWN xAI API key, a secret in /etc/harness/env/global.env on the hub only (env-templates/lanes/377-archie-research.env.example). The X half refuses to call when it is unset or equals XAI_API_KEY or GROK_CODE_XAI_API_KEY (the grok runner's keys), with one ALERTS line a day. NOT settable from the control plane.

Read by bin/archie-research.sh as ${JOBS_BODY:-}: the jobs worker's last response body, set by _jobs_req (bin/lib/jobs/req.sh), kept as the answer of a refused claim (terminal or attempt cap). Plumbing, not a knob. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/archie-research.sh uses as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: seconds the scan may spend before it stops starting scoring calls, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 (else 1700). NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: a file bin/archie-research.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam gate: bin/archie-research.sh honours ARCHIE_NOW and sources ARCHIE_RESEARCH_FIXTURE only when this is 1. Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.

0 makes this lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row, so the stop is visible in the ledger rather than being a lane that went quiet. Covers the web-scan and scoring agent-calls; the direct xAI X search is outside agent-call and stops on ARCHIE_RESEARCH_ENABLED or the cap.
Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs this lane may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. today's ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call.
Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend, never from the box's own logs/cost.csv.
